reuse.why: The tree already has getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts deciding missing/number/range amounts, but the change edits an inline ternary instead of changing or calling that helper.

duplication.why: It rewrites one of several inline copies of the ranged-amount dispatch (forecast-schedules, schedules/app twice, schedule-template, getScheduledAmount remain on the midpoint), leaving the rule duplicated and now divergent.

placement.why: The edit is in the shared schedules module, but in a preview function's inline expression rather than the module's exported amount helper.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule with a targeted test; no unrelated edits, though it covers only the preview path.

maintainability.why: The rule now differs between upcoming previews and posting, forecasts, rule sync, templates and UI that use getScheduledAmount, so a maintainer must chase many copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keeps its own inline range resolution instead of using/changing getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline missing/number/range ternary is an openly repeated copy of the existing dispatch, not reshaped to hide it.

one_place.where: Changed only in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions; getScheduledAmount (shared/schedules.ts), server/schedules/app.ts (two sites), server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still use the midpoint.
